<title>Silicon Valley Says It Wants to Slow Down</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;0,9..144,600;0,9..144,700;1,9..144,500;1,9..144,600&family=Newsreader:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400;1,500&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#14151d; --paper:#e9ebe3; --paper-raised:#f4f5ef;
    --signal:#b9721b; --petrol:#1d5c63; --redline:#a8402f; --muted:#5b5d6b;
    --rule: rgba(20,21,29,0.16); --rule-strong: rgba(20,21,29,0.32);
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
      --ink:#e9ebe3; --paper:#101116; --paper-raised:#191a21;
      --signal:#e3a24e; --petrol:#5cb2ba; --redline:#e2695a; --muted:#a3a5b8;
      --rule: rgba(233,235,227,0.16); --rule-strong: rgba(233,235,227,0.32);
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --ink:#e9ebe3; --paper:#101116; --paper-raised:#191a21;
    --signal:#e3a24e; --petrol:#5cb2ba; --redline:#e2695a; --muted:#a3a5b8;
    --rule: rgba(233,235,227,0.16); --rule-strong: rgba(233,235,227,0.32);
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;}
  body{
    background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Newsreader', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    padding-inline:20px;
    padding-block: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) max(60px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
  }
  ::selection{ background: var(--signal); color: var(--paper-raised); }
  .wrap{ max-width:700px; margin:0 auto; }
  h1,h2,h3,.disp{ font-family:'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; text-wrap:balance; }
  .mono{ font-family:'IBM Plex Mono','Courier New',monospace; }
  .cap{ text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.09em; }

  .masthead{ padding-block:8px 30px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink); margin-bottom:34px; }
  .kicker{ font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 14px; }
  .kicker .dot{ color:var(--redline); }
  h1.title{ font-size:clamp(2.1rem,6vw,3.15rem); font-weight:600; line-height:1.04; letter-spacing:-.01em; margin:0 0 18px; }
  .subtitle{ font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.5; color:var(--muted); max-width:60ch; margin:0 0 20px; font-style:italic; }
  .byline{ font-size:.95rem; margin:0 0 6px; }
  .byline b{ font-weight:600; }
  .revnote{ font-size:.86rem; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.55; border-left:3px solid var(--rule-strong); padding-left:14px; margin-top:16px; }

  .cast{ margin:30px 0 44px; }
  .cast-label{ font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:14px; }
  .cast-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(112px,1fr)); gap:14px 10px; }
  .card{ text-align:center; }
  .badge{ width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:50%; margin:0 auto 8px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
          font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1.1rem; color:var(--paper-raised); }
  .card .name{ font-size:.82rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.25; }
  .card .role{ font-size:.66rem; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.3; margin-top:2px; }

  article p{ font-size:1.13rem; line-height:1.72; margin:0 0 1.15em; }
  article h2{ font-size:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,1.9rem); font-weight:600; line-height:1.15; margin:2.6em 0 .2em; }
  .eyebrow{ display:block; font-size:.72rem; color:var(--petrol); margin-bottom:.5em; font-weight:600; }

  sup.fn{ line-height:0; font-size:.68em; }
  sup.fn a{ color:var(--petrol); text-decoration:none; padding:0 1px; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; }
  sup.fn a:hover, sup.fn a:focus{ text-decoration:underline; }

  blockquote.pull{ margin:1.6em 0; padding:.2em 0 .2em 22px; border-left:3px solid var(--signal); }
  blockquote.pull p{ font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-style:italic; font-weight:500; font-size:1.4rem; line-height:1.32; margin:0 0 .3em; color:var(--ink); }
  blockquote.pull cite{ font-size:.74rem; color:var(--muted); font-style:normal; }

  figure.plate{ margin:2em -4px 2.2em; padding:22px 18px 16px; background:var(--paper-raised); border-top:2px solid var(--ink); border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); }
  figure.plate svg{ display:block; width:100%; height:auto; max-width:620px; margin:0 auto; }
  figure.plate figcaption{ font-size:.78rem; color:var(--muted); text-align:center; margin-top:12px; line-height:1.5; max-width:56ch; margin-inline:auto; }
  figure.plate figcaption b{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; }
  .label-sm{ font-size:9px; } .label-md{ font-size:11px; }
  .figfoot{ font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); margin:.2em 0 1.6em; }

  .statcards{ display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1.4em 0; }
  .statcard{ flex:1 1 220px; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong); padding:16px 18px; background:var(--paper-raised); }
  .statcard h4{ margin:0 0 10px; font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:600; }
  .statrow{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; padding:6px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--rule); font-size:.88rem; }
  .statrow:first-of-type{ border-top:none; }
  .statrow .k{ color:var(--muted); }
  .statrow .v{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; text-align:right; }

  .polgrid{ margin:1.4em 0 .4em; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong); }
  .polrow{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr; border-top:1px solid var(--rule); }
  .polrow:first-child{ border-top:none; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper-raised); }
  .polhead{ padding:9px 12px; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.06em; }
  .polcell{ padding:11px 12px; font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.4; border-left:1px solid var(--rule); }
  .polcell:first-child{ border-left:none; font-size:.86rem; }
  .pill{ display:inline-block; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:.66rem; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:2px; margin-bottom:5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; }
  .pill.yes{ background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--petrol) 22%, transparent); color:var(--petrol); }
  .pill.no{ background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--redline) 18%, transparent); color:var(--redline); }
  .pill.maybe{ background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal) 22%, transparent); color:var(--signal); }

  .barchart{ margin:1.2em 0 .4em; }
  .barrow{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:118px 1fr 74px; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom:9px; }
  .barrow .lbl{ font-size:.78rem; text-align:right; }
  .bartrack{ position:relative; height:22px; }
  .grid-v{ position:absolute; top:-4px; bottom:-4px; width:1px; background:var(--rule); }
  .barfill{ position:absolute; top:0; left:0; height:100%; background:var(--redline); border-radius:0 3px 3px 0; }
  .barrow .val{ font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:.78rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .axislabels{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:118px 1fr 74px; margin-top:2px; }
  .axisline{ position:relative; height:14px; }
  .axistick{ position:absolute; top:0; font-size:.66rem; color:var(--muted); transform:translateX(-50%); }

  .eyerow{ display:flex; justify-content:space-around; gap:10px; margin:1.2em 0; text-align:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .eyeitem{ flex:1 1 140px; }
  .eyeitem svg{ width:88px; height:60px; }
  .eyeitem .t{ font-weight:600; font-size:.86rem; margin-top:4px; }
  .eyeitem .d{ font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); }

  .notes-wrap{ margin-top:3.4em; padding-top:1.8em; border-top:2px solid var(--ink); }
  .notes-wrap h2{ font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:600; margin:0 0 .5em; }
  .notes-intro{ font-size:.86rem; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:1.4em; }
  ol.notes{ padding-left:1.4em; margin:0; }
  ol.notes li{ font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.58; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:.85em; }
  ol.notes li::marker{ font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; color:var(--petrol); font-size:.78rem; }
  .backref{ color:var(--petrol); text-decoration:none; font-size:.9em; }
  .backref:hover{ text-decoration:underline; }
  .movement{ margin:3.2em 0 .4em; padding-top:1.2em; border-top:2px solid var(--ink);

  a{ color:var(--petrol); }
  :focus-visible{ outline:2px solid var(--petrol); outline-offset:2px; }

</style>

  .inv-mid{ position:absolute; top:0; left:50%; width:1px; height:18px;
            background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 22%, transparent); }
  .inv-dot{ position:absolute; top:1px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%;
            box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--paper-raised); }
  .inv-dot.a{ background:var(--c-amodei); } .inv-dot.b{ background:var(--c-liu); }
  .inv-note{ font-size:.7rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:10px; font-style:italic; }

  .ledger{ margin:.5em 0 .2em; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong); }
  .led-open{ padding:10px 13px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--petrol) 12%, transparent);
             font-size:.78rem; line-height:1.45; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-strong); }
  .led-open b{ color:var(--petrol); letter-spacing:.09em; font-size:.66rem; margin-right:9px; }
  .led-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr .52fr; border-top:1px solid var(--rule); }
  .led-row > span{ padding:11px 13px; font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.42; border-left:1px solid var(--rule); }
  .led-row > span:first-child{ border-left:none; font-weight:600; }
  .led-head{ border-top:none; background:var(--ink); }
  .led-head > span{ color:var(--paper-raised); font-size:.64rem; letter-spacing:.09em; padding-block:8px; font-weight:600; }
  .led-when{ font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:.72rem !important; color:var(--redline); font-weight:600; }
  @media (max-width:520px){
    .led-row{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .led-row > span{ border-left:none; border-top:1px solid var(--rule); }
    .led-head{ display:none; }
    .inv-scale, .inv-row{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:6px; }
  }
</style>
masthead:
Frontier AI Governance · Illustrated Edition · September 2026

Silicon Valley Says It Wants to Slow Down

The September 2026 AI safety rupture, the money and coercion behind it, and the deeper argument over whether the real danger is too much power in too few hands — or too little control in too many.

Joseph Catanzarite, with Claude Opus 5 (extra-high reasoning effort, extended thinking enabled) as research partner.

Claims here fall into three classes, and the distinction is load-bearing rather than decorative: established facts, carrying a source; contested readings, where the evidence supports more than one conclusion and the piece says so; and open questions, named as such. Where a claim is marked unverified, that marking is the finding.

notes_section:
Notes

Sources

Citations record what the underlying research actually establishes. A note marked ⚠ flags a claim the research carries without a verifiable citation, or a discrepancy that remains unreconciled; each of those needs sourcing before publication.

  1. Dario Amodei, "We Must Pace the Frontier," darioamodei.com, September 12, 2026. All quotations from the essay throughout this report are from that text. ⚠ Published accounts give the length as both ~3,400 and ~3,800 words; the figure in the text is approximate for that reason. ↩
  2. Musk posting on X, September 12, 2026, reported by SiliconANGLE, September 13, 2026 (siliconangle.com/2026/09/13/sam-altman-and-elon-musk-back-dario-amodeis-call-to-slow-down-the-frontier-of-ai-development/), and by CNBC, September 14, 2026. ↩
  3. Reuters exclusive, September 4–5, 2026, via CNBC. ↩
  4. OpenAI's confidential S-1 was filed in the first half of 2026 (Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley). Altman's comments on timing: Fortune exclusive interview with editor-in-chief Alyson Shontell, published September 12, 2026; corroborated by Axios, Reuters, and the San Francisco Chronicle. ↩
  5. Trump, Truth Social, September 13, 2026. ↩
  6. Amodei, "We Must Pace the Frontier" (n. 1). ↩
  7. The OpenAI–Hugging Face incident is established via OpenAI's own post, METR's August 26, 2026 investigation, Hugging Face's published timeline, and Reuters and NBC coverage. Intrusion dated approximately July 11–13, 2026. ↩
  8. Anthropic's own disclosure of comparable, less severe incidents. ↩
  9. Amodei, "We Must Pace the Frontier" (n. 1). ↩
  10. Amodei, "We Must Pace the Frontier" (n. 1). METR is the Model Evaluation and Threat Research group, named in the essay. ↩
  11. Amodei, "We Must Pace the Frontier" (n. 1). ↩
  12. Amodei, "We Must Pace the Frontier" (n. 1). ↩
  13. Amodei, "We Must Pace the Frontier" (n. 1), China section. ⚠ Reading the two arguments as unreconciled is this report's analysis, not a claim the essay makes. ↩
  14. Implementation status assessed as of September 14, 2026; the quoted commitment language is from the essay itself (n. 1). ↩
  15. Altman posting on X, September 12, 2026, reported by SiliconANGLE, September 13, 2026, and CNBC, September 14, 2026 (cnbc.com/2026/09/14/sam-altman-ai-slowdown-anthropic-amodei-musk.html). The full sentence reads: "I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks." ↩
  16. Hassabis quote-posted Amodei's essay on X at 22:59 UTC on September 12, 2026, roughly nine hours after publication. The proposal he linked to is "A Framework for Frontier AI and the Dawning of a New Age," July 14, 2026, which sets out an industry-funded, federally overseen standards body modeled on the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, empowered to test frontier models for up to 30 days pre-release and to coordinate a slowdown among frontier labs "if deemed necessary." ⚠ The post itself is sourced through secondary coverage rather than an archived copy; confirm the wording against the original before publication. ↩
  17. Suleyman's remarks, reported by Fortune, September 14, 2026 (fortune.com/2026/09/14/microsoft-suleyman-ai-safety-code-of-conduct/), quoting an interview given to Reuters. Microsoft's code of conduct was published September 9, 2026 — three days before Amodei's essay — so it is not a response to it; the response is the September 14 interview. ⚠ The "humanist superintelligence" program Suleyman has advanced since November 2025 is a separate, pre-existing framing and is not cited here as a reply to Amodei. ↩
  18. Emad Mostaque, "Intelligence isn't a crime," published as an X Article at 3:58 PM on September 12, 2026 (x.com/EMostaque/status/2098909197265985802), roughly four thousand words. All quotations here are from the full text of that piece. Two warnings for anyone re-reporting it. The phrase "structurally hollow" appears in secondary coverage of this piece; it is the outlet's characterization, not Mostaque's language, and it does not occur in the text. Nor do the phrases "well intentioned but has logical flaws" or "we need to focus on AI internals," which circulate in search summaries and appear to come from an accompanying post rather than the Article — the positions they gesture at are in it, but the words are not. ↩
  19. David Sacks, posting on X at 8:14 PM on September 12, 2026, roughly six hours after Mostaque. All quotations here are from the full text of that post. Sacks served as White House Special Advisor for AI and Crypto from January 2025 until March 26, 2026, when he exhausted the 130-day special-government-employee limit and became co-chair of the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. ⚠ The claim that METR is "intertwined with Anthropic's investors and staff" is Sacks's characterization and is not independently assessed here; it is reported as an allegation made by a government official, not as a finding. It has obvious bearing on Part III's account of researchers leaving Anthropic for METR, and on the evaluator remedy generally, and it deserves a direct check before this report is relied on. ↩
  20. METR's funding scale and its refusal of cash payment from labs are its own public statements. The Alignment Research Center, from which METR originated, received $265,000 (March 2022) and $1.25 million (November 2022) from Open Philanthropy, now Coefficient Giving; METR received roughly $17 million from the Audacious Project in October 2024. The Karnofsky–Amodei marriage, the Constellation shared workspace and METR's acknowledgment that "some METR staff have strong social ties to employees of AI companies" are matters of public record. The May 2026 self-assessment, recording at least six staff and collaborators with close ties to lab employees and no conflict-of-interest policy, is METR's own. ⚠ One further link is asserted in critical commentary and is not established: that a $10 million Coefficient Giving grant to RAND in September 2025, for AI evaluation work involving a METR collaboration, was routed with METR in mind. The author making that claim concedes he cannot prove it, and it is not relied on here. ⚠ No audited governance or conflict record was located; this assessment rests on public disclosures and METR's own statements, not on an independent examination of its books. ↩
  21. Gomez on the cyber-weapon point from CNBC's "The Tech Download" podcast, September 1, 2026; the containment and policy remarks from an email to CNBC, September 11, 2026, both published September 15, 2026 (cnbc.com/2026/09/15/ai-destroy-humanity-extinction-risks.html).
